Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 03 July 2025(Thursday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Bataan, Cavite, Rizal, Bulacan, Zambales and Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Tuy, Calatagan, Balayan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Laguna, Quezon, and Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga, Tarlac, and the rest of Batangas which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZISbP.
